reviews.text:
We decided to expand our patio and contacted Texas Direct for a quote based on reviews.  Spencer came out and talked us through the process and made suggestions of things that would work and what we might want to rethink.  He expertly navigated the permitting process with our city offices and had plans drawn to specifications.

Spencer drew up a timeline of the process and had contractors at our home without delay each day once the building work began.  He made sure we were happy and did everything possible to earn our business.  Every contractor we came in contact with was friendly and knowledgeable about their craft.

We LOVE our new patio, from the cedar ceiling, stone columns, specialty kitchen, TV wall, to how they merged the roofline with our current roof to make it look perfect!  We will be using them for future projects and recommend them to all of our friends and neighbors.
reviews.author: Deborah Peacock

reviews.text: TXD Pools & Patio added a patio to our home. The moment we discussed our vision with TXD Pools & Patio, they made our vision  come to life!  The craftsmanship is exceptional and the use of materials, especially the brick columns creates a feeling that it was built with the home. The addition to recessed lighting and ceiling fans makes our porch usable all year long.  We could not be more grateful to the whole team at TXD Pools & Patio, especially Jeremy Farris !!!  We will use them for more projects in the future!
reviews.author: Jennifer Blake

reviews.text: I highly recommend this company if you are looking for a beautiful backyard living space! They are very professional, detail oriented and communicate every step of the process. They provided timeline expectations and we got exactly what we wanted. We have used them for several projects and they are all wonderful and we would use them again for our next update!
reviews.author: Brandy dePlante

reviews.text: Awesome company, expert service, good pricing. What more could you ask for. The quote process was Awesome they really took the time to look at our space and recommend things we never thought about. The price was comparable to any other quote I received. Then the crew that arrived was extremely professional quick and clean. No complaints here
reviews.author: Kurt

reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this company. Jerimy Farris goes above and beyond. Always professional, on time and clean up after the job. He completed both our patio , as well as, our daughter's. Both are beautiful.
reviews.author: Lynda Jarrell

reviews.text: TXD did an awesome job on our patio/pergola!  Jerrimy and his crew gave us an awesome addition to our backyard quickly and affordably without skimping on quality. My wife says it’s her single favorite part of our house!
reviews.author: Will Massey

No negative patterns or complaints found. Likely reflects a new company's initial satisfied customers rather than manipulation.

Company is very new (founded 2024), yet has perfect ratings
authentic_signals: Specific details in reviews (Spencer, Jeremy Farris, permitting process, brick columns)
